hero.title: Write, design and run your website in one place
hero.text: Webmantle brings posts, pages, themes and SEO into one admin area. Switch themes without losing content, and edit the home page right on screen.

stats.label: Designer for the home page and every page

titlefeatures.title: Everything you need to run a content website
titlefeatures.text: From writing posts to switching themes, you do it all in the admin area.

features.title: Write and publish posts
features.text: An editor with images, categories, tags, scheduled publishing and revision history.

features.title: Static pages
features.text: About, Contact, Pricing: create standalone pages and add them to the menu.

features.title: Switchable themes
features.text: Upload a theme, preview it, activate it and roll back. Your content stays the same.

features.title: Designer
features.text: Edit text, images, links and heading levels (H1, H2, H3) on the home page and on each page.

features.title: Built-in SEO
features.text: Titles, descriptions, sitemap and robots, with checks while you write.

features.title: Roles and backups
features.text: Give your team roles and back up the database, images and themes.

titlesteps.title: From setup to your first post

process.title: Sign in
process.text: Go to /admin with the administrator account you created during setup.

process.title: Choose a theme
process.text: Open Themes, preview, then activate the one you like.

process.title: Write your first post
process.text: Posts → New post. Enter a title and content, then save a draft.

process.title: Publish
process.text: Check SEO, change the status to Published and view it on the site.
